title: Barrier Sun
description: A Barrier icon on the sun
body:
**A Barrier icon on the sun**

**Barrier Sun** is a tiny cosmetic resource pack that adds a bright pink barrier icon on top of Minecraft’s sun, while keeping the original sun visible underneath.  
It is made purely for fun and screenshots – gameplay and lighting stay exactly the same.

**Features:**

1. Overlays a glowing barrier symbol around the vanilla sun (the sun is still there)

2. Gives your sky a playful, surreal look for builds and screenshots

3. Lightweight: only tweaks the sun texture layer, with no performance impact

**License / Permissions：**

•All textures in this pack are my own edits of vanilla Minecraft assets.

•Do not re-upload this pack to other sites.

•You can use this pack in your own videos or modpacks. A credit link to this Modrinth page is not required, but it is appreciated.
